summary: REBUILD of step M1-S04 of build tier2-webhook against the 2026-09-12 amendment. The step was reset and amended by the operator and was already 'running' when this run began, so no claim transition was made here. apex-builder was re-run inline against the amended inputs{}, ApplicationLogger.cls and its meta XML were deleted from the step's artefacts, the three remaining classes were rewritten, check-outputs returned ok on all six declared outputs, and set-status built recorded the run. Three undeclared artefacts remain (the TestDataFactory copy, its meta XML and deploy-order.md), down from five, which holds confidence at MEDIUM. No blocking prerequisite is left: the round-1 P0 was decided at the plan, not deferred.
confidence_rationale: Step 9 MEDIUM row: three undeclared artefacts under artefacts/M1-S04/, and two optional inputs of the owning agent (test_bulk_size, async_hint) resolved from none of the three Step 5 sources. Everything the HIGH row asks for otherwise held - every required input resolved from plan.json, check-outputs exited 0, and no file was written outside artefacts/M1-S04/ and envelopes/M1-S04/.

process_observations.observation: The amend-step record carries who, when, why and the full prior inputs, so this rebuild could diff the amended inputs against what round 1 actually built rather than trusting a summary of the change.
The loop closed a P0 the way it is designed to: the builder reported it, the plan decided it, and the rebuild implemented the decision - no agent chose between the two remediation options.

Noticed that amend-step replaces inputs wholesale, so a superseded key survives beside its replacement: inputs.recipients and inputs.alert_recipients now say different things and nothing in validate flags the pair.

Noticed that the amendment updated templates[] but not outputs[], so the TestDataFactory copy the provenance rule still forces into the package remains undeclared - the same class of gap the round-1 envelope reported, now smaller rather than closed.
The step was already running when this invocation began, so Step 2's next/claim path did not apply; the run was appended by the operator's set-status rather than by this agent.
The rebuilt step is built and its declared tests have not been recorded by the agent that owns that record.
process_observations.followup_reason: because tests/M1-S04/results.json with passed:true is what gates built -> tested, and this agent never runs the step's acceptance tests.

process_observations.observation: The rebuild, the decision behind it and the three remaining P2 findings belong in the build's decisions log before the M1 gate.
process_observations.followup_reason: because it owns decisions.md and traceability.md, and a P0 raised, decided and rebuilt inside one milestone is exactly what the M1 gate has to see.
